title: R240 route, shared observation validator (contract rows 4, 5 and 6) and shared suite evidence upload

startup.why: desktop-control and claims-display need only bwm composing on the GT 710 through the shared GPU core and a shared observation validator that knows breengel.md 20.2's backend-6 row; both passed in the ARM baseline 20261024T012512Z-qemu-13504.

composition.why: chrome-geometry, overlap, cascade and oracle-corruption measure existing bwm composition through SCANOUT_READBACK; their probes stay clear of the cursor bwm starts at (0,0), so they need no pointer injection yet.

geometry.why: client-resize is bwm reconciling an owner-initiated RESIZE from LIST, which main bwm already does (bwm.rs:1246-1260).

lifecycle.why: compositor-steal and inject-denied are kernel authority checks (claim EBUSY, WRITE_EVENTS compositor-only) with a live bwm.
